file_insights.purpose: Backup/old views file for purchasing module
file_insights.significance: Cleanup of legacy code - removed outdated backup file containing old view implementations

patterns_discovered.description: Systematic removal of old/backup files as part of codebase cleanup
patterns_discovered.context: Views file was a backup containing 1084 lines of old Django view implementations

patterns_discovered.description: Consolidating codebase by removing duplicate or superseded implementations
patterns_discovered.context: The old views file appeared to be replaced by newer implementations elsewhere in the codebase

patterns_discovered.description: Purchasing module with clear separation of concerns (requests, orders, receivings)
patterns_discovered.context: Views were organized with comment sections for different functional areas

gotchas_discovered.description: Removing 1084 lines of code in a single commit could impact team awareness if not properly communicated
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Ensure commit message clearly indicates this is a cleanup/removal of backup file

gotchas_discovered.description: If any imports or references to views_old.py existed elsewhere, they would break
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: The successful outcome suggests no active dependencies on the deleted file

approach_outcome.result: Successfully removed legacy backup file (apps/purchasing/views_old.py) containing 1084 lines of old view implementations

recommendations.suggestion: Continue systematic removal of backup/old files to keep codebase clean
recommendations.rationale: Large backup files take up space and can cause confusion about which implementation is current

recommendations.suggestion: Ensure team is aware of which views are the current implementation
recommendations.rationale: With backup file removed, team should be clear on the single source of truth for purchasing views

recommendations.suggestion: Use git history as reference for old code rather than maintaining backup files
recommendations.rationale: Git provides full history; backup files are redundant and clutter the repository
